cards.name: confirm_sale_view
cards.spec: confirm_sale_view(request, pk) confirms the sale with that pk by calling confirm_sale(sale), imported from sales.services. If confirm_sale raises ValueError, show the error text with messages.error and change nothing. On success show the message 'Sale confirmed.' Always redirect to sales:list. Only POST is allowed.

cards.name: cancel_sale_view
cards.spec: cancel_sale_view(request, pk) cancels the sale with that pk by calling cancel_sale(sale), imported from sales.services. If cancel_sale raises ValueError, show the error text with messages.error and change nothing. On success show the message 'Sale cancelled.' Always redirect to sales:list. Only POST is allowed.

cards.name: form_valid
cards.spec: form_valid(self, form) creates the sale by calling create_sale(customer, number, date), imported from sales.services, with form.cleaned_data customer, number and date. If create_sale raises ValueError, add its text to the form with form.add_error(None, str(e)) and return self.form_invalid(form), so the form is shown again and no Sale is created. On success redirect to sales:list.
